subject: [PATCH 07/22] mm/memory_hotplug: migrate offlined pages to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the memory hotplug migration code to restrict the destination nodes for page migration to only those that are marked as N_MEMORY_COMMON. This change prevents the destination nodemask from becoming empty when migrating pages to a node that is not an eligible allocation target, which can occur in certain configurations where some nodes are marked as N_MEMORY but not N_MEMORY_COMMON.
